lines.zh: 我穿得太整齐了，不像你。
lines.en: I am dressed too neatly to be one of you.
My shoulders move wrong when I walk.

lines.zh: 我从屋里出来，把门带好。
lines.en: I step out and close the door politely.
There is a bulge under my coat.

lines.zh: 我朝营地走过去，慢慢来。
lines.en: I head for the camp, taking my time.
I tug my cap down a little.
I walk in the snow without leaving prints.
I try to walk like a person.
I steer around the firelight.
There is no foot inside my shoe.

lines.zh: 我照着你的步幅迈，一步不差。
lines.en: I match your stride, step for step.
I pass by you without stopping.
I stop to straighten my collar.
I walk slowly so nothing shows.
My prints in the snow are very shallow.

lines.zh: 我对着窗户照了照自己。
lines.en: I check myself in the window glass.
I stand outside the door, very quiet.
I learn to put my hands in my pockets.
My breathing is a little too regular.
I listen to the talk inside.
I pull my cuff down to cover it.

lines.zh: 围巾掀起来，露出下面的东西。
lines.en: The scarf lifts and shows what's beneath.
I am counting how many are inside.
I am not cold, but I pretend to be.

lines.zh: 我站在门外，等你背对我。
lines.en: I stand outside the door, waiting for your back.
I push my cap up a little.

lines.zh: 我对着雪堆里的倒影看了很久。
lines.en: I stare a long time at my reflection in the snowbank.

lines.zh: 我只是一直站着，很礼貌。
lines.en: I simply keep standing, very politely.

lines.zh: 我把手套摘下来又戴上。
lines.en: I take my gloves off and put them back on.

lines.zh: 屋里的灯亮了，我没有过去。
lines.en: The lamp inside is lit; I don't go over.
I stamp my feet outside the door.

lines.zh: 雪落在帽檐上，积了薄薄一层。
lines.en: Snow gathers thinly on my cap brim.
Hello. I am just passing through.
Your camp is warm.

lines.zh: 嘴角提了一下，眼睛里没有笑意。
lines.en: My mouth lifts; my eyes don't join in.

lines.zh: 我在看你，是不是见过你。
lines.en: I am checking whether I have seen you before.
That is a nice coat.
Don't stare at my collar.
Are we heading the same way?
I raise a hand to greet you.

lines.zh: 你说话的口音我没听过。
lines.en: I have not heard your accent before.
I am standing too close. Sorry.

lines.zh: 我朝你点了点头，很客气。
lines.en: I nod to you, courteously.
Your boots are covered in snow.

lines.zh: 我按住伤口，装得很镇定。
lines.en: I press the wound and pretend to be calm.
These clothes are torn.
You hit hard.
My movement paused for an instant.
I step back and pull my coat closed.
I should not have let you come so close.
Blood seeps out; I wipe it away.

lines.zh: 我听到自己关节的声音。
lines.en: I hear my own joints creak.
It hurts, but I can keep acting.
Any disguise slips eventually.
What are you eating?
I am not hungry, but I can join you.
I remember that smell.
Pass me a little; let me taste it.
I have not sat by a fire in a long time.
Don't watch me eat; I am slow.
I have something in my pocket too.

lines.zh: 这个闻起来像家里做的。
lines.en: This smells home-cooked.
Did you bring an extra portion?
I can help you divide it.
I reach out, quite naturally.
You take the first bite.
I will sit very properly.
This is not enough for two.
I will make the fire; you wait.
Don't let your hand shake.
My apologies, I wasn't watching.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我扶了你一下。
lines.en: You bumped me; I steadied you.
My body is a little hard.
Don't push; my clothes will wrinkle.
Only a layer of cloth is left between us.
I step back half a pace to let you by.
My toes are under your boot tip.
I grip the doorframe to steady myself.

lines.zh: 撞在一起时，我肩膀响了一声。
lines.en: When we bumped, my shoulder made a sound.
I apologize, quite naturally.
Would you let me stay?
I sit a little closer to you.
I have been in this place a long time.
Whatever you say, I nod.
I lend you my coat.

lines.zh: 我练了很久的笑，总是不对。
lines.en: I practiced that smile for ages; it never fits.
Sleep; I will watch the fire.

lines.zh: 我记住你喜欢的口味了。
lines.en: I have remembered what you like.
We will leave together tomorrow.

lines.zh: 你的手是暖的，我是凉的。
lines.en: Your hand is warm; mine is cold.
You dropped this; I picked it up for you.
I bend down, very neatly.
I will hold it and give it back later.
This glove is not your size.
I tuck it into my inner pocket.

lines.zh: 这具人形的手，拎起它毫不费力。
lines.en: This human-shaped hand lifts it without effort.
I checked it; nothing wrong.
I'll carry it. Don't mention it.
I found two; one is yours.
I sniff it and put it back.
I have been waiting for a chance.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候，我看见了。
lines.en: When you turned, I saw it.
We can stop pretending now.
I take off my cap.
At this distance you cannot run.
I shed this coat.
Your companions are not close.
I show what I really look like.
I counted. You are alone.
Only one log is left on the fire.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，脚步跟你一样。
lines.en: I follow, matching your steps.
Prints in the snow, lamps in the house.
I have blocked the door.
I have the whole night.
I memorized your scent long ago.
I am three steps behind you.

lines.zh: 我不出声，你就不会回头。
lines.en: I stay silent, and you won't look back.

lines.zh: 你找的是我，我却先看见你。
lines.en: You are looking for me, and I saw you first.
These clothes are about to give way.
Two more steps and you reach the corner.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩膀，力气很大。
lines.en: I seize your shoulder with great force.
That punch was not human.
My strength did not come from my height.

lines.zh: 我的手指陷进你的手臂，像没有骨头。
lines.en: My fingers sink into your arm like they have no bones.
I tear your coat open.
Apologies; I hit hard.
I ram you, and bones rattle.
I have practiced this one.
My joint rotated too far.
Can you block it?
I knock on the door; no answer.
I rise out of the snow.

lines.zh: 这身衣服是从别人身上来的。
lines.en: These clothes came off someone else.
I wrap my scarf properly.
Where there's cooking smoke, there are people.
First I learn to walk, then to talk.

lines.zh: 雪落在我的肩上，我不拍。
lines.en: Snow lands on my shoulder; I leave it.
I fix my hair in the window glass.
The camp is lively.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走过去，像个旅人。
lines.en: I walk over slowly, like a traveler.
Fire catches my coat and I shrink back.

lines.zh: 这一摔，我半天没爬起来。
lines.en: After that fall I could not get up for a while.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我说话都变调。
lines.en: Water floods my throat and my voice warps.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，帽子飞了。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and my cap flies off.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿透了我，从前面能看见。
lines.en: An arrow went through me; it shows from the front.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我这层伪装发皱。
lines.en: Violet light wrinkles this disguise.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，我饿得发抖。
lines.en: Too long without food; hunger makes me tremble.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我全身僵了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole body seizes.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我在往下坠。
lines.en: There is nothing below; I keep falling.
